title: '자동 핵타격' Fox News·NY Post·IBTimes·Israel Hayom·Press TV 추가 확산 — 'Dead Hand(사자의 손)' 프레이밍

source_name: Fox News / NY Post / IBTimes / Israel Hayom / Press TV
